An [[alien]] [[bounty hunter]] of the same species as [[Scrapjaw Motito]] was an '''ally''' of a [[Unidentified Kajain'sa'Nikto|Kajain'sa'Nikto raider]]. In [[9 ABY]], along with the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] and [[Unidentified Kajain'sa'Nikto's ally 2|another raider]], the alien ambushed the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] but was defeated and [[Death|killed]] by him.

==Biography==
[[File:GroguHostage-TMCh10.png|thumb|left|270px|The thief holds Grogu at knife-point.]]
The [[alien]] [[bounty hunter]] was part of a small gang of [[Thief|thieves]].<ref name="Mando Mayhem">{{InsiderCite|210|Mandalorian Mayhem}}</ref> They set a trap by concealing a rope across a gully on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], hoping to kill [[Din Djarin]] and [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]. Their plan originally worked as they knocked Djarin off his [[Zephyr-J speeder bike|Zephyr-J]] [[speeder bike]]. As Djarin fought off the other raiders, the raider attempted to capture Grogu but was shot by Djarin. The raider then pointed a rifle at him, but Djarin uses his [[fibercord whip]] to pull the rifle away, knocking the other two raiders out. The alien grabbed Grogu, holding a knife to his throat.<ref name="Chapter 10">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 10: The Passenger}}</ref>

Djarin threatened the individual, saying if he hurt Grogu, there was nowhere he could hide, but then suggested a bargain, offering to trade the valuable cargo in the wreckage, including [[Boba Fett's armor]] and a hunk of [[krayt dragon]] meat. The alien considered the offer, then demanded Djarin's [[Z-6 jetpack|jetpack]]. He agreed, removing the jetpack and placing it on the sand. The alien placed Grogu on the ground, grabbed the jetpack and ran away. Djarin picked up Grogu, activated the jetpack with his wrist gauntlet controls, sending the alien high into the air and dropping him to his [[death]].<ref name="Chapter 10" />

==Personality and traits==
The alien was the same species as [[Scrapjaw Motito]].<ref name="Chapter 10 AD" />

==Equipment==
While on Tatooine, the alien wore pale clothing and had a handheld weapon like a [[knife]], a [[boiler rifle]], and a [[DT-12 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="Chapter 10" />
